I have fixed the issue in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r5/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L28).

### Cause
In `TokenVault.kt`, the `KeyGenParameterSpec` for the Keystore AES key had `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` with biometric/device credential parameters. Because signing in with a library card does not perform biometric or device lock authentication, initializing the cipher during `TokenVault.save()` failed with `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException: User not authenticated`.

### Fix
Updated `TokenVault.kt` to set `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` on the `KeyGenParameterSpec` (and removed the associated authentication parameters), allowing the token to be encrypted and decrypted by the app using the hardware-backed Keystore key without requiring prior biometric or device lock verification.
